scope: Instruction/datasheet cross-check for 53 firmware-linked positions in the early application, including configuration-only findings. Conditional on the MC9S12T64 model and register block at zero. Per-BIN later-family and boot reviews are in analysis/firmware/pin_audit.json. This is not a board-continuity or complete functional-coverage certificate.

PA5/PA6/PA7 are inputs (DDRA=0x1F) read together as PORTA & 0xE0. With 0x08B1 bit 0x80 set and a repeated matching read: 0x80 invokes the full-range checksum test; 0x00 enters an interrupt-masked infinite loop; 0x40 enters a destructive RAM-pattern test (0x5555 / 0xAAAA over 0x0800–0x0FFE). Other patterns do not enter these tests. These are application service/test selections, not the MCU hardware mode pins. External straps or test-point routing are unconfirmed.

pins.role: GPIO output initialized high; SPI SS not selected
pins.review_note: DDRS=0xEA and PTS=0xFF initialize PS7 as a high output. SPI runs as master (SPICR1=0x50/0x54); SPICR2 has no decoded write and its reset MODFEN=0 leaves SS outside SPI control. The storage transaction strobe is PP3 instead. No dedicated PS7 toggle was found. This conclusion assumes the documented reset state; a nonstandard boot handoff can change it.
